objective: Design and implement a versioned save system for meta-progression with migration support and optional in-run snapshots.

steps.title: Define save schemas
steps.description: Create schemas/save.schema.json referencing meta-progression and snapshot schemas.

steps.title: Implement SaveData model
steps.description: Add serializable C# models under Assets/Scripts/Save matching schema.

steps.title: Migration registry
steps.description: Implement ISaveMigration, migrations, and runner that applies migrations on load.

steps.title: Persistence layer
steps.description: Implement SaveManager with atomic file write, backup, validate, load and save methods.

steps.title: Tests
steps.description: Unit tests for serialization and migration; integration test for full save/load/migrate flow.

steps.title: Docs & examples
steps.description: Add README notes and examples for manual migration and restore.

notes: Prefer atomic file operations and idempotent migrations.
Use Unity-friendly serialization. Consider Newtonsoft.Json if complex conversion is required.
Record RNG seeds and contentVersion in saves for reproducibility.
